intro: Create a private feed URL for each device. The URL is like a password: it stays here so you can copy it anytime. Rotate if leaked; the old URL stops working immediately. Editing events does not change the URL. On LAN or plain HTTP, webcal links may not open correctly in system calendars.
appleHint: On this device tap Open in Calendar. To share with iPhone / iPad, copy the webcal link and open it in Safari or Calendar. You can also expand a row and scan the webcal QR code (for Apple Calendar).
otherHint: Copy the HTTPS URL and add it via “Add by URL” in that calendar. In-app one-tap subscribe and QR subscribe are not guaranteed.
copyFailed: Could not copy automatically. Long-press the URL to copy.
qrHint: Scanning yields the same address as Copy webcal, handled by the system calendar (Apple Calendar). Google / Android may not subscribe via QR—use Copy URL for HTTPS and add it manually.
copyUnavailable: The plaintext URL was not saved during upgrade and cannot be shown again. Rotate to view a new one.
rotateDesc: The old URL stops working immediately. Resubscribe on devices with the new URL.
revokeDesc: After revoke the URL returns 404 and device subscriptions stop updating.

form.deviceExtra: Web list note only; not written into the calendar name.

picker.emptyAll: No events yet; saving creates an empty calendar
